name: What utilities are required for Zen Tiny Homes?

mainEntity.name: What utilities are required for Zen Tiny Homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard utilities include electricity, potable water, and sewage or septic systems. Optional solar power and composting toilets support off-grid living.
